title: BI-RADS-NET-V2: A Composite Multi-Task Neural Network for Computer-Aided Diagnosis of Breast Cancer in Ultrasound Images With Semantic and Quantitative Explanations.
summary: BI-RADS-Net-V2 used a learned ultrasound classifier with BI-RADS semantic and quantitative explanations on 1,192 breast-ultrasound images. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
